title: Earthquake Detection Rose 200x, But Major Quakes Did Not
hook: Earthquake detection rose 200x, but major quakes barely changed.
closing: More earthquake headlines reflect better monitoring, not proof that the planet became more violent.
question: Have you ever felt an earthquake?

segments.say: Earthquake stations reached 8,000, letting scientists hear far more shaking than early networks could detect.
Major earthquakes average 17 yearly, barely different from the earlier rate.
Detected earthquakes reached 20,000 yearly, a monitoring surge rather than a sudden planetary change.
